messages:
maya: Quick note before Friday's review — want to settle on the validation badge contrast, undo affordance, and how disabled rules appear in the compact playback.

chris: For badges: current red on white fails contrast for small text. Propose badge background #b00020 with white text or use an icon + subtle border for errors.

sam: agree on icon + text. we should show an actionable verb in the copy: e.g., 'Needs match — add condition' rather than just 'Error'.

aleks: undo: accidental reorders are frequent. propose a 6s inline snackbar: 'Moved "Route to docs" to pos 2 — Undo'. Also add a lightweight changelog entry so power users can revert later.

leo: a11y: snackbar must be focusable and announced by aria-live; focus should return to the moved rule if user activates Undo. targets >=44px.

rachel: playback visibility: disabled rules should remain visible but ghosted with tooltip 'disabled — not evaluated'. that keeps context instead of vanishing.

chris: mockup update: ghosted row with 40% opacity + dotted left border, matched rule has bolt icon + underline, validation badge shows icon+actionable text.

maya: decision checklist for review: 1) badge color + icon approach; 2) actionable validation copy; 3) undo snackbar + changelog entry; 4) ghosted disabled rules in playback; 5) a11y announce + focus return.

sam: i'll scope a quick frontend spike for the snackbar and ghosting, 1.5d.

aleks: i'll update Figma and include small GIFs for the undo flow.

ui-bot: Reminder: design-review scheduled 2026-05-08 16:00 UTC.

maya: thanks all — post Figma + acceptance criteria before the sync.
